nina: quick scan result: recurring pattern 'kv-cache stale during pod churn' seen 11 times in past 120 days. putting together follow-ups.
omar: ok let's split: repro & postmortem, infra mitigation, monitoring.
tess: i'll own infra mitigation (INF-9401) - goal: early-warm hook + safer cache invalidation.
omar: i'll draft repro + timeline and link logs (INF-9402). will use a small synthetic that forces pod churn.
infra-bot: Digest created: 'recurrence-kvchurn-2240' -> https://redwood.internal/ops/digests/2240
nina: monitoring: add two tiles and an alert. tess or omar can pick monitoring ticket.
tess: taking monitoring as well (INF-9403) - alert if kv_cache_stale_rate > 4% for 10m.
omar: tentative timelines: repro + doc by 2026-04-04, infra prototype by 2026-04-07, canary 2026-04-10.
nina: customer comms: I'll prepare internal FAQ and hold off public comms until canary results. target 2026-04-12 for customer note.
tess: infra note: will add AMI bake validation and early-warm hook; linking logs to INF-9401 once prototype runs.
omar: sample query i used for signature counts: ```sql
SELECT signature, count(*) AS hits FROM incident_signatures WHERE created_at > now() - interval '120 days' GROUP BY signature ORDER BY hits DESC;
```
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync 2026-04-11 09:30 PT.
